```{r}
# ============================================================
# CTNNA1 clonality analysis in the pILC WES cohort
# Date: 2026-09-22
#
# Inputs
#   1. Tier-1 common cohort MAF
#   2. With-PoN PCGR workbooks: SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL sheet
#   3. FACETS allele-specific copy-number segments
#   4. FACETS purity table, or purity column found in FACETS files
#
# Important
#   VAF alone is NOT used to make a definitive clonality call.
#   Clonality is assessed from purity/copy-number-adjusted CCF.
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(readxl)
})

set.seed(42)

# -------------------------------
# Paths
# -------------------------------

WES_ROOT <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES"

MAF_FILE <- file.path(
  WES_ROOT,
  "Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/",
  "Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/Tier_1_common_all_samples.combined.maf"
)

PCGR_DIR <- file.path(
  WES_ROOT,
  "Downstream/PCGR/With_PON/pcgr_outputs"
)

FACETS_DIR <- file.path(
  WES_ROOT,
  "Downstream/FACETS/Result"
)

OUT_DIR <- file.path(
  WES_ROOT,
  paste0(
    "Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/",
    "CTNNA1_Clonality"
  )
)

dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
RUN_DATE <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")

out_file <- function(stem) {
  file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(stem, "_", RUN_DATE, ".tsv"))
}

# -------------------------------
# Helper functions
# -------------------------------

clean_text <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A", "NULL")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(clean_text(x))
  x <- sub("(_T|-T|\\.T)$", "", x)
  x
}

clean_chr <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(clean_text(x))
  x <- sub("^CHR", "", x)
  x[x == "23"] <- "X"
  x[x == "24"] <- "Y"
  x
}

to_num <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", clean_text(x))))
}

pick_col <- function(dt, candidates, required = FALSE, label = NULL) {
  lower_names <- tolower(names(dt))
  hit <- match(tolower(candidates), lower_names, nomatch = 0L)
  hit <- hit[hit > 0L]

  if (length(hit)) return(names(dt)[hit[1]])

  if (required) {
    stop(
      "Could not identify ", ifelse(is.null(label), "required column", label),
      ". Tried: ", paste(candidates, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  NA_character_
}

extract_sample_from_path <- function(path) {
  hit <- regmatches(
    path,
    regexpr("TP[0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+(?:_T)?", toupper(path), perl = TRUE)
  )
  if (!length(hit) || !nzchar(hit)) return(NA_character_)
  clean_sample(hit)
}

# Normalize REF/ALT representations to a common edit key.
edit_key <- function(chr, pos, ref, alt, maf_format = FALSE) {
  chr <- clean_chr(chr)
  pos <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(pos))
  ref <- toupper(clean_text(ref))
  alt <- toupper(clean_text(alt))

  if (anyNA(c(chr, pos, ref, alt)) || pos < 1L ||
      !grepl("^([ACGTN]+|-)$", ref) ||
      !grepl("^([ACGTN]+|-)$", alt)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  # MAF insertions with REF='-' begin one base after Start_Position.
  if (maf_format && ref == "-") pos <- pos + 1L
  if (ref == "-") ref <- ""
  if (alt == "-") alt <- ""

  while (nzchar(ref) && nzchar(alt) &&
         substr(ref, nchar(ref), nchar(ref)) ==
           substr(alt, nchar(alt), nchar(alt))) {
    ref <- substr(ref, 1L, nchar(ref) - 1L)
    alt <- substr(alt, 1L, nchar(alt) - 1L)
  }

  while (nzchar(ref) && nzchar(alt) &&
         substr(ref, 1L, 1L) == substr(alt, 1L, 1L)) {
    ref <- substring(ref, 2L)
    alt <- substring(alt, 2L)
    pos <- pos + 1L
  }

  if (!nzchar(ref) && !nzchar(alt)) return(NA_character_)

  paste(
    chr,
    pos,
    ifelse(nzchar(ref), ref, "-"),
    ifelse(nzchar(alt), alt, "-"),
    sep = ":"
  )
}

pcgr_genomic_key <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_text(x)
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)

  hit <- regmatches(
    x,
    regexec(
      "^(?:chr)?([^:]+):g\\.([0-9]+)([ACGTN]+|-)>([ACGTN]+|-)$",
      x,
      perl = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  )[[1]]

  if (length(hit) != 5L) return(NA_character_)
  edit_key(hit[2], hit[3], hit[4], hit[5])
}

normalize_vaf <- function(x) {
  x <- to_num(x)
  nonmissing <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(nonmissing)) return(x)

  # PCGR may store VAF as 0-1 or as percent. Detect safely.
  if (max(nonmissing, na.rm = TRUE) > 1) x <- x / 100
  x
}

beta_ci <- function(vaf, depth, conf = 0.95) {
  if (is.na(vaf) || is.na(depth) || depth <= 0) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  alt <- max(0L, min(as.integer(round(depth)), as.integer(round(vaf * depth))))
  n <- as.integer(round(depth))
  alpha <- 1 - conf
  lower <- if (alt == 0L) 0 else qbeta(alpha / 2, alt, n - alt + 1)
  upper <- if (alt == n) 1 else qbeta(1 - alpha / 2, alt + 1, n - alt)
  c(lower, upper)
}

# CCF = VAF * [purity * total_CN + 2*(1-purity)] /
#       [purity * mutation_multiplicity]
estimate_ccf <- function(vaf, depth, purity, total_cn) {
  empty <- list(
    Mutation_Multiplicity = NA_integer_,
    CCF = NA_real_,
    CCF_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
    CCF_CI_Upper = NA_real_,
    Clonality = "Indeterminate",
    Clonality_Note = NA_character_
  )

  if (anyNA(c(vaf, purity, total_cn))) {
    empty$Clonality_Note <- "Missing VAF, FACETS purity, or total copy number"
    return(empty)
  }

  if (vaf < 0 || vaf > 1 || purity <= 0 || purity > 1 || total_cn <= 0) {
    empty$Clonality_Note <- "Invalid VAF, purity, or total copy-number value"
    return(empty)
  }

  denominator_cn <- purity * total_cn + 2 * (1 - purity)
  max_mult <- max(1L, as.integer(round(total_cn)))
  multiplicities <- seq_len(max_mult)
  ccfs <- vaf * denominator_cn / (purity * multiplicities)

  # Prefer a biologically feasible CCF. If several are feasible, choose the
  # value closest to 1. Values up to 1.20 are allowed for measurement noise.
  feasible <- which(ccfs <= 1.20)
  if (length(feasible)) {
    chosen <- feasible[which.min(abs(ccfs[feasible] - 1))]
  } else {
    chosen <- which.min(abs(ccfs - 1))
  }

  mult <- multiplicities[chosen]
  ccf <- ccfs[chosen]
  vaf_ci <- beta_ci(vaf, depth)
  scale_factor <- denominator_cn / (purity * mult)
  ccf_ci <- vaf_ci * scale_factor

  if (all(!is.na(ccf_ci))) {
    if (ccf_ci[1] <= 1 && ccf_ci[2] >= 1) {
      call <- "Clonal"
      note <- "95% CCF interval includes 1"
    } else if (ccf_ci[2] < 1) {
      call <- "Subclonal"
      note <- "95% CCF interval is below 1"
    } else {
      call <- "Indeterminate"
      note <- "CCF interval is above 1; review purity/CN/multiplicity"
    }
  } else {
    call <- if (ccf >= 0.90 && ccf <= 1.20) {
      "Likely_clonal"
    } else if (ccf < 0.90) {
      "Likely_subclonal"
    } else {
      "Indeterminate"
    }
    note <- "Heuristic call because read depth was unavailable"
  }

  list(
    Mutation_Multiplicity = mult,
    CCF = ccf,
    CCF_CI_Lower = ccf_ci[1],
    CCF_CI_Upper = ccf_ci[2],
    Clonality = call,
    Clonality_Note = note
  )
}

# -------------------------------
# 1. Read Tier-1 common CTNNA1 variants
# -------------------------------

if (!file.exists(MAF_FILE)) stop("MAF not found: ", MAF_FILE)

maf <- fread(
  MAF_FILE,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE,
  na.strings = c("", ".", "NA", "N/A"),
  skip = "Hugo_Symbol"
)

required_maf <- c(
  "Hugo_Symbol", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Chromosome",
  "Start_Position", "End_Position", "Reference_Allele",
  "Tumor_Seq_Allele2", "Variant_Classification"
)

missing_maf <- setdiff(required_maf, names(maf))
if (length(missing_maf)) {
  stop("MAF missing columns: ", paste(missing_maf, collapse = ", "))
}

maf[, Gene := toupper(clean_text(Hugo_Symbol))]
maf[, Sample_key := clean_sample(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]
maf[, Chromosome_clean := clean_chr(Chromosome)]
maf[, Position := as.integer(Start_Position)]
maf[, Variant_key := mapply(
  edit_key,
  Chromosome,
  Start_Position,
  Reference_Allele,
  Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
  MoreArgs = list(maf_format = TRUE),
  USE.NAMES = FALSE
)]

ctnna1 <- maf[Gene == "CTNNA1"]

if (!nrow(ctnna1)) stop("No CTNNA1 variants were found in the Tier-1 common MAF.")

ctnna1[, Match_key := paste(Sample_key, Gene, Variant_key, sep = "|")]

# -------------------------------
# 2. Read CTNNA1 rows from With-PoN PCGR workbooks
# -------------------------------

pcgr_files <- list.files(
  PCGR_DIR,
  pattern = "\\.pcgr\\.grch38\\.xlsx$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (!length(pcgr_files)) stop("No PCGR workbooks found under: ", PCGR_DIR)

pcgr_list <- vector("list", length(pcgr_files))
pcgr_audit <- vector("list", length(pcgr_files))

for (i in seq_along(pcgr_files)) {
  f <- pcgr_files[i]
  sample_from_path <- extract_sample_from_path(f)

  sheets <- tryCatch(excel_sheets(f), error = function(e) character())
  if (!"SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL" %in% sheets) {
    pcgr_audit[[i]] <- data.table(
      Sample_key = sample_from_path,
      File = f,
      Status = "Missing SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL sheet"
    )
    next
  }

  dt <- tryCatch(
    as.data.table(read_excel(f, sheet = "SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL", guess_max = 100000)),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(dt)) {
    pcgr_audit[[i]] <- data.table(
      Sample_key = sample_from_path,
      File = f,
      Status = "Read error"
    )
    next
  }

  needed <- c("SYMBOL", "GENOMIC_CHANGE", "VAF_TUMOR")
  if (length(setdiff(needed, names(dt)))) {
    pcgr_audit[[i]] <- data.table(
      Sample_key = sample_from_path,
      File = f,
      Status = paste("Missing columns:", paste(setdiff(needed, names(dt)), collapse = ","))
    )
    next
  }

  dt <- dt[toupper(clean_text(SYMBOL)) == "CTNNA1"]

  if (!nrow(dt)) {
    pcgr_audit[[i]] <- data.table(
      Sample_key = sample_from_path,
      File = f,
      Status = "No CTNNA1 row"
    )
    next
  }

  keep_optional <- intersect(
    c(
      "SYMBOL", "GENOMIC_CHANGE", "ALTERATION", "PROTEIN_CHANGE",
      "CONSEQUENCE", "LOSS_OF_FUNCTION", "LOF_FILTER", "VAF_TUMOR",
      "DP_TUMOR", "ONCOGENICITY", "ONCOGENICITY_CODE",
      "CALL_CONFIDENCE", "MUTATION_HOTSPOT"
    ),
    names(dt)
  )

  dt <- dt[, ..keep_optional]
  dt[, Sample_key := sample_from_path]
  dt[, Gene := "CTNNA1"]
  dt[, Variant_key := vapply(GENOMIC_CHANGE, pcgr_genomic_key, character(1))]
  dt[, Match_key := paste(Sample_key, Gene, Variant_key, sep = "|")]
  dt[, VAF_TUMOR_fraction := normalize_vaf(VAF_TUMOR)]
  dt[, DP_TUMOR_numeric := if ("DP_TUMOR" %in% names(dt)) to_num(DP_TUMOR) else NA_real_]
  dt[, PCGR_FILE := f]

  pcgr_list[[i]] <- dt
  pcgr_audit[[i]] <- data.table(
    Sample_key = sample_from_path,
    File = f,
    Status = paste0("CTNNA1 rows: ", nrow(dt))
  )
}

pcgr <- rbindlist(pcgr_list, fill = TRUE)
fwrite(rbindlist(pcgr_audit, fill = TRUE), out_file("CTNNA1_PCGR_file_audit"), sep = "\t")

if (is.null(pcgr) || !nrow(pcgr)) {
  stop("No CTNNA1 rows were found in the PCGR workbooks.")
}

# If PCGR contains duplicate annotations for the same variant, retain one row
# and combine using the median numeric VAF/depth.
pcgr_collapsed <- pcgr[, c(
  list(
    PCGR_VAF = if (all(is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction))) NA_real_ else median(VAF_TUMOR_fraction, na.rm = TRUE),
    PCGR_Depth = if (all(is.na(DP_TUMOR_numeric))) NA_real_ else median(DP_TUMOR_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    PCGR_FILE = paste(unique(PCGR_FILE), collapse = ";")
  ),
  lapply(.SD, function(x) paste(unique(na.omit(as.character(x))), collapse = ";"))
), by = .(Match_key, Sample_key, Gene, Variant_key), .SDcols = setdiff(
  names(pcgr),
  c(
    "Match_key", "Sample_key", "Gene", "Variant_key",
    "VAF_TUMOR_fraction", "DP_TUMOR_numeric", "PCGR_FILE"
  )
)]

# Join MAF variants to PCGR annotations.
maf_keep <- intersect(
  c(
    "Match_key", "Sample_key", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Gene",
    "Chromosome_clean", "Position", "Start_Position", "End_Position",
    "Reference_Allele", "Tumor_Seq_Allele2", "Variant_key",
    "Variant_Classification", "HGVSc", "HGVSp", "HGVSp_Short"
  ),
  names(ctnna1)
)

result <- merge(
  unique(ctnna1[, ..maf_keep]),
  pcgr_collapsed,
  by = c("Match_key", "Sample_key", "Gene", "Variant_key"),
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

result[, PCGR_Match_Status := fifelse(
  is.na(PCGR_VAF),
  "No matched numeric PCGR VAF",
  "Matched"
)]

fwrite(result, out_file("CTNNA1_Tier1_PCGR_VAF_audit"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "")

# -------------------------------
# 3. Read FACETS purity RDS and CTNNA1 gene-level copy number
# -------------------------------

if (!dir.exists(FACETS_DIR)) stop("FACETS result directory not found: ", FACETS_DIR)

purity_rds_files <- list.files(
  FACETS_DIR,
  pattern = "_purity\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (!length(purity_rds_files)) {
  stop("No *_purity.rds files found under: ", FACETS_DIR)
}

facets_list <- vector("list", length(purity_rds_files))
facets_audit <- vector("list", length(purity_rds_files))

for (i in seq_along(purity_rds_files)) {
  rds_file <- purity_rds_files[i]
  sample_id <- sub("_purity\\.rds$", "", basename(rds_file), ignore.case = TRUE)
  sample_key <- clean_sample(sample_id)

  gene_file <- file.path(
    dirname(rds_file),
    paste0(sample_id, ".gene_level.txt")
  )

  x <- tryCatch(readRDS(rds_file), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(x) || !is.list(x)) {
    facets_audit[[i]] <- data.table(
      Sample_key = sample_key,
      Purity_RDS = rds_file,
      Gene_Level_File = gene_file,
      Status = "Could not read purity RDS"
    )
    next
  }

  if (!file.exists(gene_file)) {
    facets_audit[[i]] <- data.table(
      Sample_key = sample_key,
      Purity_RDS = rds_file,
      Gene_Level_File = gene_file,
      Status = "Missing gene-level file"
    )
    next
  }

  gene_dt <- tryCatch(fread(gene_file, data.table = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(gene_dt) || !nrow(gene_dt) ||
      !all(c("gene", "tcn.em", "lcn.em", "cf.em") %in% names(gene_dt))) {
    facets_audit[[i]] <- data.table(
      Sample_key = sample_key,
      Purity_RDS = rds_file,
      Gene_Level_File = gene_file,
      Status = "Unreadable gene-level file or missing gene/tcn.em/lcn.em/cf.em"
    )
    next
  }

  gene_hit <- gene_dt[toupper(clean_text(gene)) == "CTNNA1"]

  if (!nrow(gene_hit)) {
    facets_audit[[i]] <- data.table(
      Sample_key = sample_key,
      Purity_RDS = rds_file,
      Gene_Level_File = gene_file,
      Status = "CTNNA1 absent from gene-level file"
    )
    next
  }

  # Normally one CTNNA1 row is expected. Prefer PASS and a row not spanning
  # multiple segments if the annotation file contains duplicates.
  if ("filter" %in% names(gene_hit)) {
    gene_hit[, filter_rank := fifelse(toupper(clean_text(filter)) == "PASS", 0L, 1L)]
  } else {
    gene_hit[, filter_rank := 0L]
  }

  if ("spans_segs" %in% names(gene_hit)) {
    spans_value <- tolower(clean_text(gene_hit$spans_segs))
    gene_hit[, spans_rank := fifelse(spans_value %in% c("true", "t", "1", "yes"), 1L, 0L)]
  } else {
    gene_hit[, spans_rank := 0L]
  }

  setorder(gene_hit, filter_rank, spans_rank)
  gene_hit <- gene_hit[1]

  get_optional <- function(column, default = NA) {
    if (column %in% names(gene_hit)) gene_hit[[column]][1] else default
  }

  purity_value <- if (!is.null(x$purity) && length(x$purity)) {
    as.numeric(x$purity[1])
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  ploidy_value <- if (!is.null(x$ploidy) && length(x$ploidy)) {
    as.numeric(x$ploidy[1])
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  facets_list[[i]] <- data.table(
    Sample_key = sample_key,
    FACETS_Purity = purity_value,
    FACETS_Ploidy = ploidy_value,
    FACETS_Flags = paste(x$flags, collapse = ";"),
    FACETS_EM_Flags = paste(x$em_flags, collapse = ";"),
    FACETS_Genome = "hg19",
    CTNNA1_FACETS_Chromosome = as.character(get_optional("chrom")),
    CTNNA1_Gene_Start_hg19 = to_num(get_optional("gene_start")),
    CTNNA1_Gene_End_hg19 = to_num(get_optional("gene_end")),
    FACETS_Segment_Start_hg19 = to_num(get_optional("seg_start")),
    FACETS_Segment_End_hg19 = to_num(get_optional("seg_end")),
    FACETS_Total_CN = to_num(get_optional("tcn.em")),
    FACETS_Minor_CN = to_num(get_optional("lcn.em")),
    FACETS_Segment_CF = to_num(get_optional("cf.em")),
    FACETS_CN_State = as.character(get_optional("cn_state")),
    FACETS_Filter = as.character(get_optional("filter")),
    FACETS_Spans_Segments = as.character(get_optional("spans_segs")),
    FACETS_Purity_RDS = rds_file,
    FACETS_Gene_Level_File = gene_file
  )

  facets_audit[[i]] <- data.table(
    Sample_key = sample_key,
    Purity_RDS = rds_file,
    Gene_Level_File = gene_file,
    Status = "CTNNA1 purity and copy-number data read"
  )
}

facets_dt <- rbindlist(facets_list, fill = TRUE)
facets_audit_dt <- rbindlist(facets_audit, fill = TRUE)

fwrite(
  facets_audit_dt,
  out_file("CTNNA1_FACETS_file_audit"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

if (is.null(facets_dt) || !nrow(facets_dt)) {
  stop("No usable CTNNA1 FACETS purity/copy-number records were found.")
}

# Gene-level matching is intentional: FACETS is hg19 and PCGR/MAF is GRCh38.
# Never directly overlap their genomic coordinates without liftover.
result <- merge(result, facets_dt, by = "Sample_key", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

result[, LOH := fcase(
  is.na(FACETS_Minor_CN), "Unknown",
  FACETS_Minor_CN < 0.5, "Yes",
  default = "No"
)]

result[, FACETS_Low_Purity_Flag := grepl(
  "low purity",
  FACETS_EM_Flags,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)]

result[is.na(FACETS_EM_Flags), FACETS_Low_Purity_Flag := NA]

# -------------------------------
# 4. Estimate mutation CCF and call clonality
# -------------------------------

ccf_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(result)), function(i) {
  estimate_ccf(
    vaf = result$PCGR_VAF[i],
    depth = result$PCGR_Depth[i],
    purity = result$FACETS_Purity[i],
    total_cn = result$FACETS_Total_CN[i]
  )
})

ccf_dt <- rbindlist(ccf_list, fill = TRUE)
result <- cbind(result, ccf_dt)

# Do not issue a firm call where CTNNA1 spans more than one FACETS segment.
spans_true <- tolower(clean_text(result$FACETS_Spans_Segments)) %in%
  c("true", "t", "1", "yes")

result[spans_true == TRUE, `:=`(
  Clonality = "Indeterminate",
  Clonality_Note = paste0(
    "CTNNA1 spans multiple FACETS segments; ",
    "mutation-level hg19 liftover is required"
  )
)]

result[, Missing_Data := apply(
  .SD,
  1,
  function(z) paste(names(z)[is.na(z)], collapse = ";")
), .SDcols = c("PCGR_VAF", "PCGR_Depth", "FACETS_Purity", "FACETS_Total_CN")]

setorder(result, Sample_key, Position)

fwrite(
  result,
  out_file("CTNNA1_clonality_results"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

summary <- result[, .(
  CTNNA1_Variants = .N,
  CTNNA1_Mutated_Samples = uniqueN(Sample_key),
  Variants_With_PCGR_VAF = sum(!is.na(PCGR_VAF)),
  Variants_With_FACETS_Purity_CN = sum(
    !is.na(FACETS_Purity) & !is.na(FACETS_Total_CN)
  ),
  Clonal = sum(Clonality == "Clonal", na.rm = TRUE),
  Subclonal = sum(Clonality == "Subclonal", na.rm = TRUE),
  Likely_clonal = sum(Clonality == "Likely_clonal", na.rm = TRUE),
  Likely_subclonal = sum(Clonality == "Likely_subclonal", na.rm = TRUE),
  Indeterminate = sum(Clonality == "Indeterminate", na.rm = TRUE),
  CTNNA1_with_LOH = sum(LOH == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
  FACETS_Low_Purity_Flagged = sum(FACETS_Low_Purity_Flag == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
)]

fwrite(summary, out_file("CTNNA1_clonality_cohort_summary"), sep = "\t")

cat("\nCTNNA1 clonality analysis completed.\n")
cat("FACETS source: *_purity.rds plus *.gene_level.txt (hg19)\n")
cat("PCGR/MAF source: GRCh38; matched to FACETS by sample and gene, not coordinates.\n\n")
print(summary)
cat("\nMain result:\n", out_file("CTNNA1_clonality_results"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Summary:\n", out_file("CTNNA1_clonality_cohort_summary"), "\n", sep = "")
```
